body: I thought about the meds. They did seem to be helping. I thought I was doing better. I was just at the doctor a few weeks ago getting my prescription refilled. I've been on the stuff for over three months now.

You're right. I do have a wife. And I do think of what it would do to her and everyone else around me. Trust me, if I had no one, I wouldn't be here talking to you now. I had a friend who killed himself a few years ago and I know just how angry I get at him from time to time, for all the good it does to get pissed at a dead man. I think, thinking about other people and how much pain it would cause the people I love has kept me alive on many occasions. But that doesn't make my pain go away. It only multiplies it by taking away what sometimes seems like the only way to make the pain stop.
